Grant all privileges on all tables in the public schema to the public role

The provided tools do not support executing SQL commands that modify permissions or schema. They are limited to running read-only queries. Therefore, I cannot assist with granting privileges. You would need to use a database administration tool or interface with appropriate permissions to execute such a command.
